[IAOT.3.3] The Rete atoms (`AlphaNode`, `BetaNode`, `TerminalNode`) are emitted whenever the
artefact is to be interpretable — `rete_builder` runs by default, and
`--emit-aot` on its own is what suppresses them. `--emit-aot` adds the
`CompiledCode` atoms; it does not gate the Rete network unless it is given alone.
